授業科目の概要.授業科目区分: Subjects in Humanities and Social Science

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: This class is designed to give an overview of some of the main philosophical texts and trends from the history of philosophy. As unexpected as it may seem, some texts from the past centuries, by Plato or Nietzsche for example, still address contemporary world problems. Their relevance and limit will be discussed in order to better understand today’s world. The class is thus also designed to strengthen the students’ critical thinking. Some of the topics covered will be: being, death, religion, violence, war, and gender among other topics.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: No prior knowledge of philosophy is needed.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
Warning: regarding the use of generative/conversational AI such as ChatGPT
Generative/conversational AI is potentially a useful tool in your study but its use in
course work needs special care. Such AI often generates plausible but incorrect
information, which leads to a poor work if you do not critically evaluate AI-generated
texts. Ethically, copying someone else's writing and making it your own is strictly
prohibited as academic misconduct at Kyushu University. A report created by simply
using a tool such as ChatGPT (copying and pasting) may be recognized as copying
someone else's writing. Especially in foreign language courses, you will not learn
anything by copying AI-generated answers.
